newsitem.title: USA: Reuters to offer news via IBM infoMarket.
newsitem.headline: Reuters to offer news via IBM infoMarket.

text.p: Reuters NewMedia Inc, a U.S.-based subsidiary of Reuters Holdings PLC, and IBM Corp said Tuesday they agreed to offer Reuters news and historical information through the IBM infoMarket service.
The agreement with IBM makes available via the Web parts of the Reuters Business Briefing database, Janet Pistone, executive vice president of Reuters NewMedia, said.
Using Cryptolope technology, IBM infoMarket allows content providers to sell their material on the Internet, while providing the means to track its distribution, payment and authenticity.

Reuters NewMedia will offer Reuters World Service, Reuters Business Report, Reuters Corporate World News Service and Reuters/Variety Online Entertainment Report on the IBM infoMarket later this year at a cost-per-item-retrieved basis.

Through the IBM infoMarket, Reuters has made its database accessible to a worldwide audience of millions with "the confidence that the company can track and bill delivered content," Jeff Crigler, vice president and managing director of IBM infoMarket, said in a statement.
IBM infoMarket is located at http://www.infomarket.ibm.com.
